```sql
WITH RECURSIVE demand AS (
    -- Seed: every order line in Canada in 2023 requires its own product (qty_per = 1)
    SELECT
        sol.order_id,
        sol.line_id,
        p.product_number AS code,
        1.0::DOUBLE      AS qty_per,
        sol.order_qty,
        so.order_date
    FROM sales_order_line sol
    JOIN sales_order so
        ON so.order_id = sol.order_id
    JOIN sales_territory t
        ON t.territory_id = so.territory_id
    JOIN product p
        ON p.product_id = sol.product_id
    WHERE t.name = 'Canada'
      AND so.order_date >= DATE '2023-01-01'
      AND so.order_date <= DATE '2023-12-31'

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursion: expand BOM edges valid on the order date, multiplying qty per unit along each path
    SELECT
        d.order_id,
        d.line_id,
        uc.child_code,
        d.qty_per * uc.qty,
        d.order_qty,
        d.order_date
    FROM demand d
    JOIN u_composition uc
        ON uc.parent_code = d.code
       AND uc.valid_from <= d.order_date
       AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR d.order_date <= uc.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(qty_per * order_qty) AS total_demand
FROM demand
WHERE code = 'PD-R853';
```

```sql
    JOIN u_composition c
```
```sql
        ON c.parent_code = b.code
```

```cypher
       WHEN m3.product_number = 'CR-7833' AND v1 AND v2 AND v3 THEN r1.qty * r2.qty * r3.qty
       WHEN m4.product_number = 'CR-7833' AND v1 AND v2 AND v3 AND v4 THEN r1.qty * r2.qty * r3.qty * r4.qty
       WHEN m5.product_number = 'CR-7833' AND v1 AND v2 AND v3 AND v4 AND v5 THEN r1.qty * r2.qty * r3.qty * r4.qty * r5.qty
       WHEN m6.product_number = 'CR-7833' AND v1 AND v2 AND v3 AND v4 AND v5 AND v6 THEN r1.qty * r2.qty * r3.qty * r4.qty * r5.qty * r6.qty
       ELSE 0.0
     END AS factor
RETURN sum(l.order_qty * factor) AS total_demand
```
